quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on his and Bol Bol's role for the team
quotes.excerpt: Me and Bol Bol for the team, whatever is asked of us we're going to do.
quotes.quote: Me and Bol Bol for the team, whatever is asked of us we're going to do. I feel like Bol Bol has been playing great starting. I feel like I do good things when I'm starting too, so whatever the coaches want we're going to do.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro says he and Bol Bol are ready for whatever role the Suns coaching staff needs from them this season. Whatever is asked of us we are going to do.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on the chemistry of the second unit
quotes.excerpt: That second group has great chemistry. I love playing with them.
quotes.quote: That second group has great chemistry. I love playing with them. I feel like me and Bol Bol both come in here every day and prepare to start. We're both ready and I'm sure there's going to be games or matchups that call for one way or the other, but neither of us is worried about that. We want to go out there and win.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro says the Suns second unit has great chemistry and both he and Bol Bol are preparing every day to start if called upon.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on Bradley Beal's offseason work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He's always locked in but we were really pushing each other in the weight room this summer.
quotes.quote: He's always locked in but we were really pushing each other in the weight room this summer. I can feel like you can see it on his drives, his physicality. He's in a really good place right now. I love how he's been playing, playing with a lot of confidence. I think he's going to have a big year.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro says Bradley Beal is playing with a lot of confidence and expects him to have a big year after seeing his work in the weight room this summer.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on his memories of Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: Everyone kind of fanboying over him growing up, just how he carried himself.
quotes.quote: Everyone kind of fanboying over him growing up, just how he carried himself and how he impacted the city and you could tell he loved basketball. Everyone in Arizona has a positive perspective of him. While I was at college, I was in Milwaukee during the finals and just the respect that he got, how he played in that run, I have nothing but positive things to say about him.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro reflects on growing up watching Kevin Durant and the respect he has for the way KD carries himself.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on his ability to impact the game without the ball
quotes.excerpt: Reading how you can impact the game when you don't have the ball.
quotes.quote: Reading how you can impact the game when you don't have the ball and being ready for the next action is an advantage of mine. I process the game at a good level that way. If I can be ready to do the next thing before my defender is, everything defensively will be a step behind.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro identifies his ability to process the game and impact play without the ball as a key advantage for his development.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on Devin Booker being the oldest player on the team
quotes.excerpt: Dylan at 30 is the oldest guy on the team.
quotes.quote: Dylan at 30 is the oldest guy on the team. It's a big milestone. It's a blessing. I'm excited to see what he does this year.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro shares his excitement for Devin Booker entering his 30s as the oldest player on the Suns roster.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro on ongoing contract extension discussions
quotes.excerpt: We're talking about it. We'll see what happens in the next couple days.
quotes.quote: We're talking about it. We'll see what happens in the next couple days. I want to be here for sure.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro confirms he is in contract extension talks with the Suns and says he wants to be here.
